name: algorithmika-course-project
description: Игровой тренажёр по алгоритмам для детей

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names backend,frontend,site --prefix-colors blue,magenta,green "npm run start:dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend" "node scripts/show-dev-url.mjs"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix frontend
